card.name: Second word of label subsection headings
card.fires_on: The word right after a section heading starter in drug-label subsections, mainly "Category" after Pregnancy and "Use" after Pediatric. It also fires on a few similar heading-like words, such as "Location" after Cytogenetic.

modes.label: Pregnancy Category
modes.description: The word Category right after the heading Pregnancy, before a letter such as C or D.
modes.example: Pregnancy<< Category>> C Animal reproduction studies have shown fetal abnormalities

modes.label: Pediatric Use
modes.description: The word Use right after the heading Pediatric, which opens the pediatric subsection.
modes.example: Pediatric<< Use>> Safety and efficacy in patients under the age

modes.label: Other heading endings
modes.description: A closing heading word in other label-style headings, such as Location after Cytogenetic or harm after fetal.

card.plain: It marks the last word of a short subsection heading in a drug label, such as Pediatric Use or Pregnancy Category.
